{{Quote|As remote a world as can be found in known space, my lord.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />}}
'''Naos III''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], near [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. Because of its [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position, Naos III should have been a frozen ball of muddy [[Water/Legends|ice]] covered by regular snowfalls, but intense [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity kept the surface just warm enough to melt the [[Water/Legends|ice]] into a thick sludge. With [[Standard day/Legends|days]] that never seemed to end, for most of its short [[Standard year/Legends|year]] the moon’s continued habitation owed to a [[Color/Legends|pink]]-fleshed delicacy [[Fishing/Legends|fished]] from the ice-covered rivers that plunged turbulent and roaring from a surround of nearly sheer [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Known as the [[Naos sharptooth]], the [[Fish/Legends|fish]] spawned only in the coldest [[Standard month/Legends|months]], was shipped offworld, flash-frozen, and sold at exorbitant prices in eateries from [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==History==
===Settlement and early history===
Little more than a mud-covered frontier world, this small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] originally was settled by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi’lek]] criminals, lured by the hope of discovering rich veins of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in Naos III’s [[Volcano/Legends|volcanically]] heated [[Cave/Legends|cave]] systems.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|360|Naos III}}</ref> Indigenous [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]] and carnivores had been hunted to [[Death/Legends|extinction]] early on by those same [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]. The creatures most often seen currently were bovine [[Rycrit/Legends|rycrits]] and woollier-than-normal [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]. The dispirited [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] who had colonized the moon had never bothered to award a name to their principal population center, so it, too, was known as Naos III. Visitors expecting to find a typical [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] found instead a cluster of fortified hilltops, interconnected by bridges that spanned a delta of waterways. As befitted a place with such a dearth of creativity, the moon had attracted nomads and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] of dubious character, eager either to lose or reinvent themselves. While Rodians and Lethan Twi’leks comprised the majority, [[Human/Legends|humans]] and other humanoids were well represented. A few wealthy [[Fisher/Legends|sportfishers]] arrived each [[Standard year/Legends|year]], but Naos III was simply too remote and too lacking in infrastructure to support a tourist trade.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />

Still, few locals banked enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy passage off Naos III, preferring instead to return their meager earnings to [[Naos III Mercantile]], which oversaw the sharptooth industry and owned nearly every store, [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] parlor, and [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. The moon had low-slung [[Prefabricated ground base/Legends|prefab buildings]], icicles decorated almost every building. The streets were mostly damaged [[ceramacrete]] paving, and very little of the local [[Weather control/Legends|climate control]] machinery were in good repair, in keeping with the local ethos. The streets were known to be mucky and dangerous, with little sanitation, and debris being shuffled to the side of the roadway.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />

===Clone Wars===
[[File:ObiWanKenobi-SoD3.png|thumb|right|200px|Obi-Wan Kenobi (pictured) was targeted on Naos III]]
During the last [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] hoped to [[Death/Legends|murder]] 
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Naos III in an effort to "orphan" [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Kenobi's friend and former student. He ordered his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], otherwise known as [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] Dooku, to ensure Kenobi’s death. Dooku was hesitant, since it clearly meant that Sidious wanted to take Skywalker as a future apprentice<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" /><ref name="CSWE" /> while Dooku wanted to see Kenobi take that place.<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had been searching for Lethan Twi'lek [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Fa'ale Leh]] as part of their [[Hunt for Darth Sidious|ongoing investigation]] into the many connections Sidious had throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. According to the intel described by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Thal K'sar]] on [[Escarte/Legends|Escarte]], the Lethan Twi'lek pilot had originally delivered a prototype [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scimitar/Legends|infiltrator vessel]] to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], Sidious's first apprentice. She pointed the Jedi in the direction of [[The Works/Legends|The Works]], a derelict area of decrepit [[Factory/Legends|factories]] and warehouses on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />
